title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the size of a teacup, who glides in slow figure-eights through a tank of moonlit teal water. Each time she turns, she leaves a faint trail of glowing bubbles that hum like a music box. She keeps a collection of smooth pebbles and polished sea glass in the ruins of a tiny teacup-shaped castle, and rearranges them whenever she thinks no one is watching.
